Subject: Deployment mode: Hosted vs Dedicated vs Private - HIPAA qualification

Hi Marissa,

Thanks again for the call earlier — good to meet you and get an overview of Redwood. Quick recap from our side and a few asks so we can qualify the deployment mode for Elara:

- Use case: PHI processing for clinical intake and summarization (low-latency chat + batch summarization jobs).
- Scale: ~100 concurrent clinical agents at peak, sustained embeddings workload for nightly indexing.
- Compliance requirements: HIPAA (BAA required), SOC2 Type II evidence, audit rights (annual), and 7-year log retention for certain records.
- Data residency: US-only.
- Encryption: must have encryption at rest and TLS 1.2+ in transit; KMS/HSM preferred.

Questions we have to help recommend deployment mode:
1) Can you share current SOC2 Type II report and the period covered?
2) Do you have a BAA template we can review?
3) For HIPAA workloads, what do you recommend: Hosted API with BAA, Dedicated reserved capacity, or Private VPC/on-prem? Pros/cons we should consider (latency/throughput, audit support, support SLA).
4) Lead times and cost ballpark for Dedicated vs Private VPC.

If possible, please send SOC2 evidence and a draft BAA — we can loop in procurement/security. Also cc'ing my colleague Tom for sizing questions.

Thanks,
Samantha Reed
Head of Integrations
Elara Health

Hi Samantha — great meeting you as well. Appreciate the clear summary; I wanted to follow up with a concise recap, attach the items you asked for, and propose next steps.

Recap / recommendation:
- Short answer: For PHI and your scale, we typically recommend Redwood Dedicated (reserved capacity) or Redwood Private (VPC/on-prem) depending on how much isolation and audit access you need.
  - Redwood Dedicated: Dedicated GPU pools, strong data isolation, predictable throughput and simpler operational model for most enterprise customers. Supports BAA and we can provide SOC2 Type II report and audit evidence for the service.
  - Redwood Private (VPC or on-prem): Best if you need direct control of networking, customer-managed KMS/HSM, or on-site audits. Longer lead time and higher upfront setup cost but enables full network isolation and tailored logging/retention.
  - Hosted API (with BAA): Possible if you want fast time-to-value and agree to the constraints we discussed (limited network egress controls and multi-tenant control plane). We offer BAA for Hosted in many cases, but for Elara's requirement around annual on-site audits and 7-year log retention we usually see Dedicated or Private as the safer fit.

Attachments included: Redwood_SOC2_Report_2026.pdf (SOC2 Type II, period 2026-01-01 to 2026-12-31), Redwood_BAA_Draft_Elara.docx (editable BAA draft), Redwood_Deployment_Options_OnePager.pdf (comparison table + lead times).

Immediate next steps I propose:
1) Security deep-dive with our security engineer (suggest Tue/Thu next week) — we'll cover KMS options, key rotation, logging retention and audit support.
2) Sizing workshop with our infra team to validate Dedicated capacity numbers for 100 concurrent agents and nightly embedding batch jobs.
3) Procurement: review BAA + cost estimates (I'll prepare a Dedicated + Private one-pager with ballpark pricing).

Logistics: I've cc'd Neha (our solution architect) to coordinate the security/tech calls. If that timeline works, Neha will send a calendar invite with a short agenda.

Let me know if you want us to prioritize Dedicated estimate vs Private. Our initial leaning based on your requirements is Dedicated for lower lead time and predictable costs; Private if Elara requires on-site audits and full control over KMS.

Best,
Marissa Cole

Thanks Marissa — received the SOC2 and BAA draft, and the one-pager is helpful. Quick responses and a few follow-ups from security/procurement:

- SOC2: we see the period listed; can you confirm there are no unresolved exceptions and whether penetration test results are available for the last 12 months?
- BAA: we'll review and provide comments; can you confirm who at Redwood signs BAAs (standard signatory or VP/Legal)?
- KMS/Encryption: can you confirm support for customer-managed keys (Cloud KMS/HSM) in both Dedicated and Private options and whether keys can be rotated on our schedule?
- Audit rights/logging: for Dedicated, can you provide a sample logging schema and confirm retention controls up to 7 years (we can accept tiered archival)? For Private, we assume full control.
- Pricing/lead time: please prioritize a Dedicated capacity ballpark estimate and lead time. If Dedicated meets our audit needs, that will likely be the quickest path.

Can we schedule the security deep-dive on Tuesday 30 March at 10am PT? That time works for our security lead Tom.

If you can send the dedicated estimate by end of day Monday (29 Mar), that will help procurement.

Thanks — cc'ing Tom who will handle sizing questions.

Samantha
Head of Integrations, Elara Health
